literature_notes: All three ledger lines describe C-terminal or positionally ambiguous tags on SCN3B. L1 (PMC11532958) explicitly places GFP at the cytoplasmic C-terminus of rat β3, which is intracellular (residues 181–215 per topology landmarks). L2 and L3 (PMC7079131) describe 'β3-myc' (suffix naming convention = C-terminal myc, also intracellular) and 'pEGFP-β3' (prefix naming = N-terminal EGFP fusion); however, neither clip states a residue number, neither confirms the tag is extracellular, and for pEGFP-β3 the relationship of the EGFP to the signal peptide cleavage site (residues 1–22) is unresolved — an EGFP upstream of the SP would be cleaved off, and the clip provides no evidence it is placed after residue 22. Because no ledger line grounds an extracellular tag at a stated or topology-derivable position, zero surface sites qualify. The only extracellular region of SCN3B is the single Ig-like domain (residues 23–159); no insertion in this domain is reported in the ledger.

literature_other_positions.note: GFP fused to the cytoplasmic C-terminus of full-length rat SCN3B (SCN3B-gfp); the C-terminus (residues 181–215) is intracellular per topology landmarks.

β3-myc construct (suffix naming = C-terminal myc tag) expressed in transfection experiments; C-terminus of SCN3B is intracellular, confirmed by L1 showing C-terminal GFP is cytoplasmic in the same protein.
